summary: TestQuantityParse now iterates a fresh quantityTestcases() slice per loop and adds an up-front check that ParseQuantity caches the string and that String() matches the expected canonical form. It only exercises existing parsing code and strengthens assertions, so a line-by-line review can be skipped.
headline: TestQuantityParse uses fresh test cases and checks cached canonical strings
reason: Test-only change that adds assertions and swaps a shared table for a per-loop generator; no production behavior is touched.
